Enable face authentication to automatica: Whakahohea te motuhēhēnga kanohi kia wetewetehia aunoatia tō keyring takiuru, tō KWallet rānei, i te takiuru. Ka penapena haumaru tēnei i tō kupuhipa — kua hiritia ki roto i te TPM ina wātea, kua whakamunatia rānei ki te AES-256-GCM mā te kī matua mā te root anake. Ka whakaritea e te motuhēhēnga kanohi a PAM_AUTHTOK mō pam_gnome_keyring, mō pam_kwallet5 rānei, i runga anō i tō papamahi.

We're done! Ubuntu Hello is now active o:
Kua oti tatou! Kei te hohe a Ubuntu Hello i runga i tenei rorohiko. Ngana ki te mahi i nga mea katoa me pato koe i to kupuhipa hei whakamotuhēhē, penei i te whakahaere whakahau me te sudo. Mēnā i whakahohea e koe te wewete-aunoa, ka wetekina aunoatia to hiri takiuru, KWallet ranei ina takiuru.

Ka taea e koe te whakatuwhera i te Ubuntu Hello Configurator a muri ake nei ki te huri i nga tautuhinga matatau ake, ki te taapiri tauira taapiri ranei. Pēhia te Mutu ki raro hei kati i tēnei matapihi ka whakatuwhera i te Ubuntu Hello Configurator.
Because of changes in angles, distance,: Na te rereke o nga koki, te tawhiti, me era atu mea ka kore te rite o te ahua kanohi ki te tauira kanohi kua rongoatia. I runga i tenei wharangi ka taea e koe te whakarite kia pehea te kaha o te Ubuntu Hello.
The most forgiving match and the quickes: Koinei te ōritetanga ngāwari rawa, ā, ko te tere rawa hoki ki te whakauru i a koe. Kōwhirihia tēnei mēnā he nui ake te painga o te māmā i te māro.
A strict match that still logs you in qu: He ōritetanga māro, engari ka tere tonu tō takiuru. Tērā pea kāore koe e mōhiotia mēnā kei te koki rawa tō kanohi, mēnā rānei kei tawhiti atu koe.
The strictest match, with no extra step: Ko te ōritetanga tino māro, kāore he mahi tāpiri ina takiuru koe. E tūtohungia ana.
